title: Grand Dragon Leviathan
summary: Grand Dragon Leviathan is the Legendary Titan of the Deeps. This Titan resembles a massive, green, serpentine dragon, much like Shakrit. Leviathan's wings are small with respect to its body, contrasting Shakrit's much larger wings.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Grand Dragon Leviathan was once a favoured Titan of Lord Casterwill. After his death, no Seeker was ever able to control the Titan again. [Grand Dragon Leviathan (comic)] 

Grand Dragon Leviathan rose from the canals of Venice, Italy, and fought the Huntik team along with Ignatius, Icarus, Kipperin and King Basilisk. [The Curse of Venice]

Sophie Casterwill used it to dive down deep underwater with the Huntik team. [Mission to Skara Brae]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Grand Dragon Leviathan is extremely ferocious, with its huge size and incredible speed. It can fire devastating blasts of water from its mouth, powerful enough to destroy a building. This Titan is also able to transport [[Seekers]] underwater by creating a bubble of oxygen in his mouth for them to stand inside.
